The following is a faithful trinecription of tarea notes by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O.F.M. Cap.
REV. MAURICE E. JOACHIM CASEY
3ORI NOV. 10, 1867; ORDAINED JUNE 9TH 1911; DIED JAN. 12TH 1949. THANKS BE TO GOD:
HIS 81 years OF "TARFARE AGAINST THE ENEMIES OF OUR SOULS, THE UNBELIEVING WORLD, THE FLESH AND THE DEVIL - COMMON TO MANKIND - WERE CROWNED BY SEVERAL MONTES OF A PEACEFUL APPROACH TO A HAPPY DEATH. FOR THIS WE HAD PRAYED AND THIS WE DO CONFIDENTLY HOPE HIS DEATH WAS viz, A HAPPY TRANSISION TO THE HEAVEN-PROMISED ABODE WHERE GRATITUDE RIPEIS ITO PERFET LOVE OF GOD AND NEIGHBOR: AND WHERE ACCORDING TO ST. PAUL: " .... EYE HATH NOT SEEET, EAR HATH NOT HEARD NOR HATH IT ENTERED INTO THE HEART OF MAN TO COCEIVE WHAT THINGS GOD HATH PREPARE FOR THEM THAT LOVE HIM. "
(above note seems to be crossed out)
